description:
`validation_lease_tests.rs` and `query_tests.rs` locate the jit binary by popping `current_exe()` (`target/debug/deps/..` → `target/debug/jit`). A concurrent cargo rebuild relinking the binary makes the spawn fail with NotFound (observed: `test_validate_leases_all_valid_succeeds` panicked at validation_lease_tests.rs:98 during a review-gate suite run). Every other integration test uses `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_jit")`, which cargo guarantees is built for the test.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `validation_lease_tests.rs` and `query_tests.rs` locate the jit binary via `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_jit")`; no `current_exe()`-derived binary path remains under `crates/jit/tests/`.
- [hard] REQ-02: cargo fmt, clippy (zero warnings), and the full test suite pass.
title: Flaky test-binary spawn: use CARGO_BIN_EXE_jit instead of current_exe-derived path
